The Project Gutenberg eBook of The Tale of the Patient Snail

*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE TALE OF THE PATIENT SNAIL ***

[Illustration]

Once there was a snail who wanted to see the top of the garden wall.
It was very high.

[Illustration: The snail looks up]

"Too slow!" laughed the sparrow. The snail said nothing,
and kept on climbing.

[Illustration]

It rained. The snail waited under a leaf. Then it climbed again.

[Illustration]

At the top, the whole garden shone below. The snail was glad it had kept on.

*** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE TALE OF THE PATIENT SNAIL ***
